params.name: height
params.description: A comma-separated list of block heights to get. This parameter is incompatible with `start_height` and `end_height`.

params.name: start_height
params.description: The start height of the block range to get. Must be used together with `end_height`. This parameter is incompatible with `height`.

params.name: end_height
params.description: The ending height of the block range to get. Must be used together with `start_height`. This parameter is incompatible with `height`.

params.name: expand
params.description: A comma-separated list indicating which properties of the content to expand.

params.name: select
params.description: A comma-separated list indicating which properties of the content to return.

items.docs: Get block data by the provided height range or list of heights.

params.name: id
params.description: A block ID or comma-separated list of block IDs.
